newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market untested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market untested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared with Wednesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well established.

Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales. Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1075-1150 lbs few 112.00-113.00.
For the week - 28,000 Wk ago - 7,600 Yr ago - 24,600
Steers/heifers: Live basis- steady. Carcass basis- steady.
